**It cannot be confirmed that the property stayed fire-free throughout the period.** NASA FIRMS recorded no thermal detections intersecting the property during the covered days from October 5 to November 3, 2026. However, all four sensors lacked coverage from November 3 to November 4.

Even during covered days, small, short-lived, cool, or cloud-obscured fires may have gone undetected. The evidence also does not establish whether any area was burned.
